name: Cocos Island National Park
story: Cocos Island is a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean administered by Costa Rica. It has an area of approximately 23.85 square kilometers and has been designated a Costa Rican National Park since 1978. Surrounded by deep waters, the island is known for its populations of hammerhead sharks, rays, and dolphins.
matters: Cocos Island National Park became a UNESCO World Heritage Site due to the unique ecology of the island and its surrounding waters. Scuba divers admire the area for its populations of large marine species.
